queer_characters.name: Hedwig (Hansel Schmidt)
queer_characters.notes: The film frames Hedwig's identity as existing between binary categories following a botched sex reassignment surgery (the 'Angry Inch'). Rep is complex/mixed as it centers a coerced surgical trauma while giving Hedwig a rich interior narrative.
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source notes Hedwig is 'often read as genderqueer/trans within queer film scholarship' rather than a clean transition; the film itself does not assign a single fixed label, and interpretations differ.

queer_creators.name: John Cameron Mitchell
queer_creators.notes: Wrote, directed, and starred, reprising his stage role; won Best Director at Sundance. Source text does not state his identity, so no identity tags are asserted.

contributor_notes: Source text describes coerced/non-consensual surgery, immigration/escape from an authoritarian state, and betrayal by a mentee, but none of these map cleanly to the available trigger_warning enum values, so trigger_warnings is left empty pending maintainer review. Hedwig's identity is drawn from queer film scholarship consensus mentioned in the source rather than an explicit in-text label, hence marked contested. John Cameron Mitchell's role is confirmed but no personal identity claim is supported by the source.
